name: Actor adds a single product to the cart
scenarioId: classpath:features/cart:Actor adds a single product to the cart
methodName: Actor adds a single product to the cart

testSteps.description: Given Actor is on the home page
When Actor adds "Combination Pliers" to the cart
Then the cart badge should show "1"

userStory.narrative:
As a customer,
  I want to manage products in my shopping cart
  So that I can review and adjust my order before checkout

title: Actor adds a single product to the cart

rule.name: Customer should be able to add products to the cart
